text.p: Tatham Offshore Inc said on Wednesday that 18,717,030 of the warrants issued earlier this year were exchanged for its Series A 12 percent Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock before July 1.
The Series A 12 percent Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock is traded under the ticker symbol "TOFFL".
In February, Tatham Offshore noted, it issued 25.1 million warrants to purchase one of three classes of preferred stock.
It said each remaining warrant entitles the holder to purchase, for $1.00 per share, one share of:

-- Series B 8 percent Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $1.00 per share and accruing dividends at the annual rate of $0.08 per share, at any time on or before October 1, or

-- Series C 4 percent Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $0.50 per share and accruing dividends at the annual rate of $0.02 per share, at any time on or before Jananuary 1.

Each warrant remaining unexercised after January 1 will be converted, without any action on the part of the holder thereof, into one share of Mandatory Redeemable Preferred Stock, which will have a liquidation preference of $0.50 per share and which the company will be required to redeem under certain circumstances.

At any time until December 31, 1998, each share of Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock (including any accrued and unpaid dividends thereon) may be exchanged for four Exchange Warrants, each entitling the holder to purchase one share of Common Stock at $0.653 per share.
The Exchange Warrants will expire on July 1, 1999.

Alternatively, each holder of shares of any series of Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock will have the right, at the holder's option, to convert the liquidation preference thereof, plus any accrued and unpaid dividends thereon, into shares of Common Stock at $0.653 per share.
